summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly disclosures: an unregistered sale of 527,106 Class I shares for $4.8M under a continuous private offering (Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S) and a declared monthly distribution of $0.0701/share across classes. The filing also updates the ongoing public offering status. There is no special-situation corporate event; the filing is a standard current report on ordinary equity sales and dividends. Nothing to watch; no risk-arb angle.
